newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 2.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 2.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- Certain parts of the privatisation contract of Budapest Bank (BB), which were disadvantegeous to the state, has been eliminated with the recent repurchase of Polgari Bank from BB, the Finance Ministry said.
- The state health care fund has concluded the financing contracts with the hospitals in every county, except the capital Budapest.
- Attila Bank of the opposition Smallholders' Party (FKGP) will receive the mandate in the Parliament of Miklos K. Csontos, who was murdered by a relative last month.
- The Budapest representative of the European Union (EU) said that Hungary and other countries in the region could join the EU in 2002 the soonest.
- The World Bank said that Hungary's health care reform halted, but for the time being the World Bank did not plan to freeze the loan supporting the reform to Hungary.
